_about: LGIC_ENFORCE round 13 fixed input. THE ONE CARRIER of the record shape (S85). R-38's population -- census rows whose canonical carries a literal placeholder brace -- finally gets its round. It is a MEASUREMENT cell for the same reason LGCTFM round 5 is: nobody has established whether the rows share ONE cause, and a cell that assumes one remedy makes the NUMBERS agree rather than the DATA.

the_population_and_its_vintage.claim: INHERITED, NOT MEASURED AT THIS CUT -- and that is the point of the cell
the_population_and_its_vintage.figure: 1411 of 3237 judged rows carried a literal placeholder brace in canonical
the_population_and_its_vintage.vintage: 0.9.0_WK_LGIC_ENFORCE~2's round-4 census (LGIC_ENFORCE-W2-S13, 2026-09-17T18:30Z), at ITS registry pin
the_population_and_its_vintage.why_it_is_not_re-measured_here: the current figure needs a live census run (`lib/opal_naming.py census --live --repo`), which is the CELL'S work and touches the live plane; running it at the cut would spend the measurement the round exists to make, at a vintage that would be stale again before the worker read it. ROUNDS 5 THROUGH 12 DID NAMING WORK ON THIS SURFACE, so the population may have moved in EITHER direction.
the_population_and_its_vintage.the_bar_that_follows: THE CELL RE-MEASURES ITS OWN DENOMINATOR AT ITS OWN WRITE TIME and states the delta against this inherited figure, naming both vintages. An inherited count wearing a fresh date is the failure this project has spent two rounds repairing in its own instruments.
the_population_and_its_vintage.a_probe_this_seat_did_run: the newest census REPORT artifact (NAMING_CENSUS_REPORT.r8.md) carries 51 table lines and ZERO placeholder lines -- but it is a SUMMARY table, not the 3237-row dump, so it neither confirms nor refutes the population. It is recorded here so the cell does not mistake it for evidence either way.

what_the_cell_answers.q1: HOW MANY rows carry a literal placeholder in canonical NOW, over what denominator, at what registry vintage.
what_the_cell_answers.q2: WHICH DISTINCT PLACEHOLDER TOKENS appear, and how many rows each accounts for -- the subtraction, not a forward list.
what_the_cell_answers.q3: WHICH PRODUCER leaves each one unfilled -- named at a code site, with the instrument that attributed it.
what_the_cell_answers.q4: WHETHER the rows share ONE cause or several -- stated as a measurement, never assumed to make a remedy simpler.
what_the_cell_answers.explicitly_not_asked: how to fill them. A remedy is the next round's question.

the_criterion_bar.claim: held -- the CTO's round-4 analysis, binding at CUT time and applied to every criterion below
the_criterion_bar.statement: Before a criterion ships, ask: CAN A CORRECT ARTIFACT SATISFY THIS? Where the honest answer is no, THE CRITERION IS THE DEFECT, NOT THE CELL.
the_criterion_bar.applied: Each criterion was built against a hand-made CORRECT record, driven in the checker's self-test as a POSITIVE-SATISFIABILITY arm. An UNATTRIBUTED row is ADMISSIBLE when named with its reason -- what is refused is SILENCE -- and the no-repair arm grades the CELL'S OWN COMMITS BY AUTHOR, never the tree (W1-S39).

stale_proof_bar.claim: held -- the repaired predicate with both residuals
stale_proof_bar.statement: SET EQUALITY against the proofs that could actually be stale; the COUNT is informational and checkout-dependent; a failed retrieval RAISES rather than returning the value that PASSES; ONE ordered git log over all watched paths.
